subject: Demo recap + activation checklist proposal — Verdant Ventures trial
messages:
From: Karhtik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@verdantventures.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + activation checklist proposal — Verdant Ventures trial

Hi Sara — thanks again for a great demo today. Quick recap from our side and a proposed activation checklist to get a 4-week evaluation running smoothly. Attaching a one-page checklist and a short runbook (see attachments).

Summary of discussion:
- Primary use case: document summarization + internal knowledge search for sales enablement.
- Success signals you mentioned: 1) extractive summaries reduce prep time by 40% for reps, 2) average relevance precision >= 0.7 on your internal test set, 3) integration with SSO + row-level access enforcement.

Proposed activation checklist (high level):
1) Tech validation (2 weeks)
   - Provision a dedicated sandbox model instance (Redwood Dedicated light).
   - Ingest a 10k-doc sample (anonymized) and validate indexing/parsing.
   - Run a throughput test: target 50 requests/sec sustained; capture 95th pct latency.
2) Acceptance tests (2 weeks)
   - Run 5 canonical scenarios from your playbook; success = relevance precision >= 0.7 and latency SLO met.
   - Security validation: SOC 2 evidence review + KMS integration check.
3) Ownership & comms
   - Redwood owners: SE lead: Karhtik Iyer; CS lead: Lauren Bishop; Solutions Engineer: Ben Carter.
   - Verdant owners: Sara Lin (Product), Mark Hoffman (CTO).
4) Decision gate
   - If acceptance tests pass, discuss Dedicated capacity commit and SLA options.

Next steps / asks:
- Can you confirm the 10k-doc sample will be available by Nov 11?
- Are there any other success metrics you want added (precision/recall thresholds, latency p50/p95)?
- Please confirm SOC 2/region requirements (we saw you noted EU data residency as a preference in the form).

Attachments: Verdant_TRIAL_Activation_Checklist_v1.xlsx (xlsx), redwood-poc-runbook.pdf (pdf)

I can schedule a 30-minute kickoff for next Tuesday (Nov 10) if that works for you.

Thanks — look forward to getting this underway.

—
Karhtik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@verdantventures.com>
To: Karhtik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Hoffman <mark.hoffman@verdantventures.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 09:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo recap + activation checklist proposal — Verdant Ventures trial

Thanks Karhtik — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Sample data: we can deliver a 10k-doc anonymized bundle by Nov 12 (we need one extra day to scrub PII).
- Throughput/latency: the 50 req/s target sounds right for peak daytime traffic; an important acceptance criterion for us is p95 latency < 200ms for single-turn queries.
- Security/residency: Verdant operates primarily in the US but some documents must remain in EU storage for regulatory reasons. Can Redwood support a hybrid residency setup for the trial (sandbox in US, EU subset for sensitive docs)?
- Instrumentation: we'd like to capture end-to-end metrics (query time, token counts, cost per request) and have an event hook for labeling returned summaries for feedback loops.

Two additional asks: 
1) Can you include a short checklist item for the integration work with our SSO (Okta)?
2) Will you assign someone to own measurement and dashboards (we'd like to track the precision metric automatically)?

If you can incorporate these into the runbook, Nov 10 kickoff is fine — suggest 10am PT.

Thanks,
Sara
Product Manager — Search & Insights
Verdant Ventures

Subject: Re: Demo recap + activation checklist proposal — Verdant Ventures trial

Sara — great notes, thanks. I've updated the activation checklist and runbook to reflect the items below. Key updates:

- Instrumentation & dashboards: Monica Patel (cc'd) will own metric instrumentation and dashboard setup on the Redwood Console. She'll provision default dashboards for p50/p95 latency, tokens per request, and a custom precision metric that we can ingest from your labeling flow.
- Residency: We support a hybrid trial. We will provision a US sandbox for general docs and a EU-segmented instance for the subset you flag as regulated. Security team will provide a short checklist for KMS/HSM configuration and SOC 2 artifacts.
- Okta SSO: Ben will lead the SSO integration (SAML). We usually complete SSO integration as part of the 2-week tech validation; please share a staging Okta config and the SAML metadata XML.
- Throughput & latency: We'll instrument a synthetic load test and an embedded run of your test set. Goal: demonstrate 50 req/s with p95 < 200ms. If we observe tail latency issues, we'll try batching and quantization profile adjustments as mitigations.

Proposed schedule (updated):
- Nov 10, 2026 10:00am PT: Kickoff call (30m) — agenda: scope, owners, access.
- Nov 11–24: Tech validation window (2 weeks) — ingest sample, SSO, run tests.
- Nov 25–Dec 2: Acceptance tests & labeling (1 week) + buffer week for adjustments.
- Decision review: Dec 3 — discuss committed capacity and SLA.

I pulled this into our HubSpot deal and linked the updated assets here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/VERD-847. 

Attachments added to the drive: Verdant_TRIAL_Activation_Checklist_v1.xlsx (updated), redwood-poc-runbook.pdf (updated).

Will send a calendar invite for Nov 10 at 10am PT; Monica, Ben, and Lauren will join to cover instrumentation, SSO, and CS engagement.

—
Karhtik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Looking forward to it.

Best,
Sara
